test_lazy_linear_before_init: test that lazy.Linear throws UninitializedLazyModuleError when accessing parameters before initialization
test_lazy_linear_after_init: test that lazy.Linear exposes parameters correctly after calling init_lazy_modules with sample input
test_lazy_linear_forward: test that lazy.Linear produces correct output shape and resolves to nn.Linear with inferred in_features
test_lazy_linear_no_bias: test that lazy.Linear with bias=False resolves to nn.Linear without a bias parameter
test_lazy_in_sequential: test that init_lazy_modules resolves lazy.Linear nested inside an nn.Sequential container
